Use case: logo-brand and product-mockup. Create ONE beautifully art-directed landscape brand identity concept board for South Savory, a South Indian food brand. The supplied original logo is the identity reference. Evolve it into the specific direction below, preserving brand-name spelling exactly "South Savory". Show the same new identity consistently across every application. Layout: left 45 percent clean flat logo artwork large and legible, a small social-profile icon below, and three palette swatches; right 55 percent a realistic takeaway food box, upright paper carry bag, and round seal sticker with soft natural daylight. Generous space, editorial composition. Only text allowed is "South Savory" and the short concept label specified below. No slogans, no invented business claims, no stock logos, no watermarks. No extra panels or alternate design directions within this board. This is a distinct creative proposal, not a minor recoloring of the original.
Direction: BOLD & EVERYDAY. A punchy contemporary food brand, inviting and energetic. Palette: vivid orange #F36B16, warm cream #FFF6E7, dark espresso #292015. Design a custom chunky rounded serif wordmark in two stacked lines "South" and "Savory", strong compact silhouette, playful confident proportions, thick readable strokes and subtle customised terminals. This wordmark is the main signature, much more prominent than the symbol. Create a small simplified interlocking SS emblem from matching curved letter strokes with two deliberate orange dots where visible; ensure it reads as letters, not 88. No arch, fine lines, formal heritage ornaments, or establishing date.
Left backdrop cream with large espresso/orange wordmark and small orange social-profile square carrying a cream SS. Concept label "01 / BOLD & EVERYDAY". Right: bold orange takeaway box with oversized cream South Savory wordmark; cream paper carry bag with very large orange wordmark; espresso round sticker with cream SS. Broad simple orange and cream blocks on packaging, no botanical patterns. Modern casual food brand, confident typography, crisp print, realistic tactile cardboard.

Direction: SOUTHERN HERITAGE. A distinctive restrained South Indian heritage identity, crafted but approachable. Palette: deep banana-leaf green #173E2D, ivory #F5EEDC, muted turmeric #D7A338. Primary logo is an elegant circular seal. Around the seal perimeter put only the words "South Savory" in beautifully spaced readable serif lettering. Within it create a custom continuous-line SS monogram, clearly two S letters, with a subtle four-loop kolam geometry integrated into the surrounding seal construction. Two small turmeric dots recall the original mark. Thin double circle border and generous negative space; no crown, no crest, no faux royal iconography, no founding year, no elaborate filigree. Keep enough line weight for practical food-label use.
Left ivory backdrop with large green seal, secondary simple horizontal South Savory serif wordmark underneath, and green social icon with ivory SS. Concept label "02 / SOUTHERN HERITAGE". Right: ivory takeaway box with green circular seal on lid, green paper carry bag carrying ivory seal, round green sticker with ivory seal. Restrained repeating kolam line pattern confined to packaging edges. Beautiful everyday food packaging, no gold foil, no luxury perfume aesthetic, soft natural daylight.

Direction: WARM & HANDCRAFTED. A contemporary South Indian food identity with a warm personal handmade character, polished rather than rustic. Palette: terracotta #B94E33, pale rice cream #F7EADB, deep aubergine #432C38. Primary identity is a flowing custom hand-lettered "South Savory" wordmark, readable distinctive brush-like lettering with a gently rising rhythm and rounded terminals, no generic cursive font. Create an original compact SS monogram inspired by one continuous kolam line, with the upper curves open enough to read as S letters rather than 88, and two small terracotta dots as a link to the original. Wordmark and icon should feel like a family.
Left rice-cream backdrop with large aubergine hand-lettered South Savory wordmark, terracotta SS icon above, small terracotta social-profile circle below with cream SS. Concept label "03 / WARM & HANDCRAFTED". Right: rice-cream takeaway box with wide terracotta paper band carrying cream wordmark; cream carry bag with large aubergine wordmark and terracotta icon; terracotta round seal sticker. Add a very restrained abstract flowing line motif from the SS to one side panel. No leaves, no food illustrations, no cartoon mascots, no arch, no founding year. Soft warm daylight, tangible uncoated paper, meticulous packaging typography.
